content.text:
**Submitted (deviation, preferred level).** Final state of the two operative edits:

1. **21.1 (p0089)** — cap reset to "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000", removing the illusory defined "Fees" (one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) and the first-Order-Form limitation, with the lookback anchored to the claim.

2. **21.3 (p0091)** — the payment sentence now tracks the checklist term directly: "Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement and any Order Form are not damages subject to the cap in this Section." Earlier phrasings ("undisputed amounts due", "obligations to pay amounts due") still read as a subset or as a general "not limited by" statement rather than payment obligations as a class excluded from capped damages; this wording states the exclusion in the checklist's own terms.

Everything else in Section 21 is untouched: the mutuality sentence, the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion with the Customer-favourable direct-damages list in 21.2, and the complete Excluded Claims set. Definitions 1.5/1.6 remain intact so the fees, invoicing and ordering mechanics that use "Fees" continue to operate, with no dangling references. I have kept the verifier's point about lowercase "fees" versus the narrow defined term as a negotiation fallback (amending 1.5) rather than adding non-element language to the redline.
